Package Network

Class NetworkMessage

java.lang.Object
Network.NetworkMessage
public final class NetworkMessage extends Object
Utility class responsible for creating and parsing network messages used for multiplayer communication. Messages are encoded in a structured format: senderId, messageType, and optional payload data. Provides helper methods for encoding/decoding strings, building messages, and splitting received data.
